surfaces.notes: spec.md instance 8, root-caused in research.md section 1 and MEASURED on OLAMNIT against build eea87e02. The ack is durable -- it survives the process dying, on disk and through `alerts`. The STARTUP REPLAY PATH re-raises alerts from the retained WAL entry and clobbers the record, re-stamping arrived_utc to the restart time, with frames_accepted=0. Fix shape: replay must merge by message_id, never overwrite; or origin_high_water must advance so replay knows the message was delivered. NOT patched here -- the client is canonical and a fourth rival client is the failure this fleet has already paid for twice.

surfaces.notes: MEASURED DURING IMPLEMENTATION, 2026-09-06: a shell round-trip wrote literal backspace bytes (0x08) where word-boundary escapes were intended, so every pattern required a character that never occurs. The audit ran, wrote a report, emitted a receipt and exited 3 -- and found 1 hit where ground truth had ~400. Exit code and report presence were both fine. Only asserting on content only the completed work could produce caught it. That is FR-010, demonstrated on this feature's own tool within ten minutes of writing it, and it is why test_scan_finds_a_known_planted_decision_site exists.
